requirements.statement: In each set of pages, the site map page is reached from an identical feature.

citations.quote: Dans chaque ensemble de pages, la page « plan du site » est-elle accessible à partir d’une fonctionnalité identique ?

routes.statement: Compared with the client-side generated source of another page of the same set, the means of access to the site map is the same, for example a link or a button.

citations.quote: Comparer le code source (généré côté client) des deux pages et vérifier que le moyen d’accès au plan du site est toujours le même (un lien ou un bouton, par exemple) ;

rationale.text: The test compares two pages: the methodology picks another page of the same set and compares the means of access to the site map in their generated source. A check runs on one target and sees one page, so it cannot make that comparison. Finding the means of access also needs judgment: it is whatever link or button leads to the site map page, and which page is the site map, and which pages form a set, are established by the human. No axe rule is tagged and no custom check is registered. The entry is none. Applicability is judgment: a site without a site map makes the test not applicable, which code cannot establish from the page examined. Needs is empty: the missing input is another page of the set, which no prerequisite covers.

citations.quote: Choisir une page de l’échantillon appartenant au même ensemble que la page en cours d’audit ;
Pages web liées les unes aux autres par des liens et constituant un ensemble cohérent à l’intérieur d’un site web.
